answer: Pair identities at random each epoch and require them to co-write a negotiated agreement live, in one shared synchronous session: each side must draft, respond, and sign with its own quill in real time, and the session only counts if both contributions interlock. One operator can hold a single conversation at a time, so a farm of clones faces a ridge it cannot climb — a thousand simultaneous sessions need a thousand live minds. Like a lotus that opens once, each pairing blooms one shared record, and clones reusing one operator's answers collapse into identical text and are slashed together.
